Selected academic work

Projects

Engineering concepts brought together through design, fabrication and mechatronics.

PROJECT 01 · 2024

Mechatronic Door Lock with Intelligent Security System Features

Developed a smart locking concept integrating a solenoid lock with motion detectors, proximity sensors and an RFID reader. The system was designed to improve access verification and automated locking/unlocking, supported by a detailed CAD model and optimized spring design.

MechatronicsSensorsCAD DesignSecurity System
PROJECT 02 · 2023

Mechatronic Design of Mars Rover

Designed a four-wheeled prototype concept with self-recovery capability after toppling and onboard camera-based data capture. Gyroscopes, accelerometers and motor-control mechanisms were used to analyse orientation and support recovery and navigation.
